xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Commissioner (Appeals), CGST, Central Excise & Customs, Bhubaneswar, Odisha
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Dalmia Cement Bharat Limited (DCBL), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, had appealed against an earlier Order demanding tax of Rs.1,54,089/- along with interest and penalty amount of Rs. 15,409/- due to ineligible input tax credit claimed for FY 2019-20 due to non-filing of GSTR-3B by the supplier. In appeal the tax demand has been waived but the penalty has been confirmed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: As the Order in appeal has been issued u/s 73 of CGST Act, related to Financial Year 2019-20, the imposed penalty is subject to waiver u/s 128A of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 as per Finance Act (2) 2024. Accordingly, there will be no financial impact on DCBL.

In appeal the tax demand has been reduced but the penalty has been confirmed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: As the Order in appeal has been issued u/s 73 of CGST Act, related to Financial Year 2019-20, the imposed interest and penalty are subject to waiver u/s 128A of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 as per Finance Act (2) 2024. Accordingly, there will be no major financial impact on DCBL.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Joint Commissioner - State Tax & GST, Rourkela II Circle, Panposh, Odisha.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited (DCBL), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, received an Order from the Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Rourkela II Circle, Panposh, Orissa, demanding tax of Rs 13,54,448/- along with interest and penalty of Rs. 1,35,444/-, pertaining to demand of GST under RCM on payment of license fees to the State for drawing of natural water for industrial use at Rajgangpur, Orissa.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Order do not have any major financial impact on DCBL and the same is limited only to the extent of tax liability along with interest and penalty amount. The transaction is being held taxable by the Deptt., though the same has been exempted from levy of GST by Notification issued by CBIC. DCBL has represented the matter before the Commissioner of State Tax at the State Tax HQ for an appropriate conclusion.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Assistant Commissioner, Unit-C State GST, Guwahati, Assam
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited (DCBL), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, received an Order from the Assistant Commissioner of Taxes, Unit-C, Guwahati, Assam demanding tax of Rs.7,006/- along with interest and penalty of Rs.10,000/-, under section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017, pertaining to wrongful availment of ITC against vendors who have not filed their monthly GSTR-3B and subsequent cancellation of his GST registration.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Order do not have any major financial impact on DCBL and the same is limited only to the extent of tax liability along with interest and penalty amount. DCBL has a good case on merits to defend the matter before the Appellate Authorities and will appeal against the said Order before the Commissioner (Appeals) within prescribed timelines.
